create_dissociation_neb_frames: create AutoFrameDissociation to generate NEB frames for a dissociation reaction on a surface slab
create_transfer_neb_frames: create AutoFrameTransfer to generate NEB frames for an adsorbate transfer reaction between two sites
create_desorption_neb_frames: create AutoFrameDesorption to generate NEB frames for an adsorbate desorbing from a surface slab
interpolate_neb_frames: interpolate between initial and final ASE Atoms frames with overlap correction for NEB calculations
check_adsorbate_bonding: check if an ASE Atoms frame respects the expected adsorbate-adsorbate edge list using covalent radii
